name: Mermaid
description: Renders the mermaid widget type with Mermaid: flowcharts, sequence, class, state, ER, Gantt and more, from the diagram text that any backend returns.

widgets.name: Mermaid diagram
widgets.description: A diagram drawn by Mermaid from text, with zoom and pan

response.description: The Mermaid diagram text as a JSON string, or as {"diagram": "<text>"}. The endpoint gets theme=dark or theme=light.

artifact.description: A diagram drawn from Mermaid text: a flowchart, sequence, class, state, entity-relationship, Gantt, pie, mindmap, timeline or git graph. Use it when a process, structure or schedule reads better as a picture.

skills.description: How to show a diagram with the Mermaid component: which diagram type fits, the syntax that draws reliably, and its limits.
